id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, same as Firebase Auth UID.

businessId.description: The ID of the business owned by the user.

Business.title: Business
Business.description: Represents a business in the system.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the business.

businessType.description: The type of business (e.g., shop, supermarket, food, service).

currency.description: The currency code for the business (e.g., NG, GH).

plan.description: The selected subscription plan for the business.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the business was created.

onboardingCompleted.description: Indicates whether the onboarding process for the business is completed.

Inventory.title: Inventory
Inventory.description: Represents a raw material or inventory item.

name.description: The name of the inventory item.

category.description: The category of the inventory item.

unit.description: The unit of measure for the inventory item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the inventory item was created.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product offered by a business.

price.description: The selling price of the product.

cost.description: The cost price of the product.

quantity.description: The current stock quantity of the product.

isPublishedToMarket.description: Indicates if the product is visible on the public marketplace.

description.description: Public-facing product description for the marketplace.

category.description: Public-facing product category for the marketplace.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the product was created.

businessId.description: The ID of the business that made the sale.

productId.description: The ID of the product sold.

productName.description: The name of the product sold (denormalized).

amount.description: The total amount of the sale.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product sold.

paymentType.description: The payment method used (e.g., cash, pos, transfer).

source.description: The source of the sale (e.g., pos, market).

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the sale occurred.

MarketProduct.title: MarketProduct
MarketProduct.description: A denormalized, public-facing product for the marketplace.

businessId.description: The ID of the business selling the product.

createdAt.description: Timestamp from the original product creation.

definition.description: Top-level collection for all business data. Each document is owned by a user.
Subcollection for inventory items belonging to a business.
Subcollection for products belonging to a business.
Subcollection for sales transactions belonging to a business.
Publicly readable collection of products listed on the marketplace.
